Let’s Explore Sharjah’s Iconic Tourist Places with a Rental Car

Popular places to visit in Sharjah with friends and family are the Sharjah Art Museum, the bustling souks, and the fascinating Sharjah Heritage Area. These iconic tourist places are thrilling adventures to explore. Experience the freedom to explore at your own pace and make unforgettable memories while exploring these iconic tourist places.

Sharjah Museum of Islamic Civilization

This museum shows Islamic civilization and displays the rich history and cultural legacy of Islamic culture. Visitors can explore its extensive collection of antiquities, which includes calligraphy, ceramics, and scientific instruments.

Al Noor Island

One of the amazing Sharjah tourist places for a family is this island with its butterfly house, artistic installations, and verdant gardens. This island is a beautiful place, like heaven. It is the best place to visit for tourists. A centre of attraction for tourists to take slow walks and admire the breathtaking sculptures.

Al Qasba

This lively waterfront area is one of the most wonderful Sharjah tourist places in the UAE. It provides a fantastic fusion of food, entertainment, and culture. Enjoy delicious cuisine, visit art exhibits, and admire the Khalid Lagoon’s stunning scenery. It’s the perfect place to unwind and rejuvenate.

Sharjah Desert Park

There is also a desert part where visitors want to explore the desert’s natural beauty. This place is the best place to visit in Sharjah with friends. You can find educational exhibits and the best spot for nature lovers.

Sharjah Art Museum

This art museum shows a collection of historic art. In this museum, tourists can explore cultural heritage and modern and historic cultural art. It is one of the best Sharjah tourist places to visit. Visit this museum and admire the works of renowned artists.

Sharjah Aquarium

If you want to explore the underwater journey, this aquarium is the best option to visit for those visitors because it showcases diverse marine life. Tourists can explore the underwater world with its 20 tanks, housing over 100 species, including sharks, rays, and colorful fish. It is an educational and entertaining experience for all ages.

Sharjah Al Fisht Beach and Park

Al Fisht Beach in Sharjah is an ideal spot to walk on the white sands, browse the beach, and enjoy a picnic.  The Al Fisht Park, located across the street from the beach, offers a well-kept lawn and a play area for kids with spacious slides, swings, and see-saws.  Parents looking for activities to do with their kids will love the park. You can bring your snack basket to a picnic on the beach and enjoy water sports with friends and family.

Sharjah Al Mamzar Beach Park

Al Mamzar Beach Park offers two of the most popular things to do in Sharjah. It features wide open spaces with palm trees that wave in the wind. Bright sun beams, soft sand, and clear ocean water for fun and adventure on the seashore.

Families with kids can head to the special kids’ section to discover more exciting things to do.  Parents can relax and enjoy beverages at a cafe while their kids play in the area.

Sharjah Islamic Botanical Garden

The Sharjah Islamic Botanical Garden is a lovely green space with approximately one hundred different plant species. The gardens have paved paths, decorative pools, and narrow streams that are based on ancient irrigation canals.

You can walk around the grounds and go to the interpretive center, which has displays and touchscreens. There is also a library full of information about plants and a cafe that serves Arabic food and beverages.

What are the Most Attractive Things to Do in Sharjah for Families?

Sharjah offers various attractions and interesting things to do for families. Here we share a few of the most popular attractions.

The Rain Room in Sharjah

Rain Room is the initial series of permanent art-designed spaces built by artists and is part of the Sharjah Art Foundation Collection.

Sharjah Al Montazah Parks

Al Montazah Parks is one of the newest places in Sharjah for families to have fun. The parks are spread over a large green area and provide fantastic experiences for the family’s entertainment.

Sharjah Sightseeing

You may now ride on a double-decker bus with an open-air top to view and observe the magnificent sights of Sharjah. Visitors may explore Sharjah’s major sights on the hop-on-hop-off bus tour.

Sharjah Children’s Farm

The Children’s Farm is the best fun for kids and families in Sharjah. There are various animals, such as Arabian horses and ponies, sheep, and a lovely duck pond. Families can take part in various kids’ summer activities, such as riding ponies and camels.
